name: Ablative Armor Layer
reason: Optional expendable outer armor layer; normally replaced rather than repaired in combat.

name: Communications Relay / Mission Communications Suite
reason: Improves contact, beacon, relay, or strategic communication options while preserving observability/provenance.

name: Scientific Laboratory
reason: Improves analysis of anomalies, samples, ruins, artifacts, and Research Data.

name: Energy / Beam Point-Defense Array
reason: Power-intensive ammunition-free beam interception.

name: Boarding / Planetary Mission Package
reason: Swappable support package improving one mission class.

name: Cargo Expansion
reason: Adds finite cargo capacity while competing directly with combat/support installations.

name: Medical Bay
reason: Mitigates explicit crew casualty and recovery outcomes.

name: Mining and Extraction Module
reason: Enables or improves extraction at eligible sites, trading time/exposure for yield.

name: Local AMM Point-Defense Battery
reason: Finite-ammunition guided terminal interception.

name: Missile Magazine Expansion
reason: Extends missile reserve; Ready Packages remain distinct.

name: Auxiliary Power Unit
reason: Preserves core-power continuity only; not normal Tactical Power generation.

name: Auxiliary Reactor
reason: Small renewable Tactical Power source with bounded output/damage behavior.

name: Combat Battery
reason: Finite flexible Tactical Power injection for a later legal window.

name: Kinetic Magazine Expansion
reason: Extends Kinetic ammunition endurance using broad magazine families.

name: Kinetic Point-Defense Battery
reason: Finite-reaction kinetic interception with ammunition.

name: Expedition Endurance Module
reason: Adds bounded Fuel/endurance support without tank-by-tank propellant bookkeeping.

name: Fuel Processor
reason: Converts eligible mined or traded Resources into the single Fuel resource at bounded time/efficiency cost.

name: Shield Battery
reason: Finite shield-specific support that does not become general Tactical Power.

name: General Fabrication Module
reason: Converts carried Resources into bounded repair or mission supplies over time.

name: Power Stabilizer / Conditioner
reason: Improves bounded power-quality/integration cases rather than adding free output.

name: Supercapacitor Pulse Bank
reason: Burst-power storage for a bounded operation/window; does not raise sustained reactor output.

name: Probe / Survey Drone Package
reason: Deployable disposable/reusable probes automate routine remote surveying and reconnaissance while preserving consequential player decisions about where to investigate and what risks to take.

name: Shield Booster
reason: Optional powered shield support distinct from the primary generator.

name: Shield Hardener
reason: Existing TL3 optional powered hardening candidate.

name: Particle / Radiation Hardening Package
reason: Specialized protection against explicit particle/radiation effects if those effects exist.

name: Damage-Control Drone Bay
reason: Robotic inspection/repair support using existing repair capacity, supplies, and condition rules.

name: Superconducting Magnetic Energy Store
reason: Advanced low-loss storage/conditioning branch.

name: Tractor / Tow Projector
reason: Bounded manipulation/towing utility for ships, wreckage, cargo, or mission objects.

name: Powered Reactive Armor System
reason: Powered specialist protection layered onto passive armor; loses active bonus when unpowered.

name: Molecular Repair Fabricator
reason: Advanced fabrication improves field repair using Resources without free resurrection.

name: Thermal Suppression Module
reason: Finite low-signature/high-output window using thermal storage/retraction abstractions.

name: Particle / Charged-Beam Deflection Screen
reason: Optional powered shield-support field tuned against charged-particle/ion/plasma-like threats rather than universal Shield Armor growth.

name: Field Stabilizer / Anti-Penetration Tuner
reason: Late specialist shield support that alters a bounded penetration/field-stability interaction rather than adding a universal defensive layer.

name: Programmable Matter Repair Patch System
reason: Configurable matter patches accelerate bounded structural/component repair.

name: Hangar / Mission Bay
reason: May add small-craft capacity, support heavier craft, or improve turnaround/safety.

name: Crystalline Armor branch
reason: validated alternate armor seed; response magnitude/lifecycle remains open
